name: pstack-zcode
description: Optional add-ons and full-collection distribution for pstack-zcode — the ZCode adaptation of Lauren @poteto's pstack workflow.

plugins.name: pstack-zcode
plugins.description: The complete pstack collection for ZCode: all 54 skills plus an optional resident-mode SessionStart hook, off by default. Installing this plugin installs everything.

description_i18n.zh-CN: pstack 全家桶：54 个技能 + 可选常驻模式 SessionStart 钩子（默认关闭）。装本插件即装齐全部。

plugins.name: pstack-resident
plugins.description: Standalone resident-mode hook for skills-route users (npx skills add): injects the condensed poteto-mode summary where poteto-mode is reachable. Skip this if you use the full-collection plugin.

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: pstack 常驻模式（npx 技能通道用）

description_i18n.zh-CN: npx 技能通道用户的独立常驻 hook；全家桶插件用户无需安装。
